:= by
  constructor
  obtain ⟨f_inv, f_inv_left, f_inv_right⟩ := IsIso.isIso_iff_exists_inv.mp [IsIso f]
  obtain ⟨g_inv, g_inv_left, g_inv_right⟩ := IsIso.isIso_iff_exists_inv.mp [IsIso g]
  refine' ⟨g_inv ≫ f_inv, _, _⟩
  rw [CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp_assoc, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp_assoc]
  exact g_inv_right.trans f_inv_left
  exact g_inv_left.trans f_inv_right
